reasoning: The development states the proposed training and demonstration in the indicative ('are trained', 'is demonstrated', 'is tested'), a modal misreading of a proposed stage. E7 gives only a condition: the Right is conditional on training outside apprentices. E3 says the lineages need the condition demonstrated; a demonstration is not stated in the cited items. E1 shows lineage crews carrying channel repair under a Special Draw Right from Book 20; outside training is not stated in the cited items. Both E3 and E7 are agent_proposed.
quote: The Special Draw Right is conditional on training apprentices from outside the lineage.
alternative_reading: Conditional reading: if outside apprentices are trained under the Special Draw Right and their repair is demonstrated, the condition the Right carries would be tested. No quote was offered; the quote given carries the condition, not the training or the demonstration.
would_settle: Record evidence (not an agent-proposed element) that outside apprentices have been trained under the Special Draw Right and that their repair has been demonstrated.
creative_room: Still possible: a stage in which outside apprentices are trained under the Right and their repair is shown, testing the condition the lineages need (E3), or one where the demonstration never comes and the Right stays exposed. Treat the training, the demonstration and the test as proposals, not record.

clauses.note: Holds only if the training and demonstration occur. E3 ties demonstration to the Right being exposed, so the link is inferential, not established.

defensible_possibility: The stage stays defensible as a proposal in conditional form: if outside apprentices were trained and their repair demonstrated, the Right's condition would be tested. E7 and E3 supply the condition and the need for it, both agent-proposed.
